_comment: Harbor AgentConfig fragment for Claude Code; eval/scripts/run.py merges it into a job.
Auth: export CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (from `claude setup-token`) on the host.
host_env is exported into the `harbor run` process, not written into the job config:
Harbor scrubs every value of an AUTH/TOKEN-named agent env var from the persisted trial
files, and a literal 'true' or '1' there corrupts trajectory.json. CLAUDE_FORCE_OAUTH drops
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY so the run bills the subscription and fails loudly without the token.
terse_import_path is the terse arm's agent class (eval/agents/terse_agents.py).
version matches the CLI preinstalled in verifier/shared/Dockerfile, so Harbor skips its install.
max_thinking_tokens is an explicit null so the host's MAX_THINKING_TOKENS cannot leak in.
max_turns is 60 for every task: the old runner's generation cap, since one Harbor job
holds one agent config. Its 10-turn cap on edit tasks does not carry over.
name: claude-code
